English/Traditional Chinese wording and every rationale checked. activeQuestion.prompt: Priya can now arrive as late as 11:15 a.m., but her other travel requirements remain unchanged. If she wants the latest possible departure, which train should she choose, and when would it arrive relative to her original arrival deadline?
activeQuestion.promptZh: Priya 現在最遲可在上午十一點十五分抵達，但其他搭車條件不變。如果她想搭最晚出發的班次，應選哪一班？該班車的抵達時間和她原本的最晚抵達時間相差多久？

options.text: Train D; 45 minutes after her original deadline.
options.zh: D 車；比原本的最晚抵達時間晚四十五分鐘。
options.whyZh: D 車是最晚出發且符合條件的班次，但十一點抵達只比原本的十點半晚三十分鐘。晚四十五分鐘的是新的最晚抵達時間，不是 D 車的到站時間。

options.text: Train B; 10 minutes before her original deadline.
options.zh: B 車；比原本的最晚抵達時間早十分鐘。
options.whyZh: B 車十點二十分抵達，確實比原本的十點半早十分鐘。不過 B 車八點半就出發，比同樣符合新條件的 D 車早。

options.text: Train C; 25 minutes before her original deadline.
options.zh: C 車；比原本的最晚抵達時間早二十五分鐘。
options.whyZh: C 車十點零五分抵達，確實比原本的十點半早二十五分鐘，但已客滿，而 Priya 不願依賴候補。

options.text: Train D; 30 minutes after her original deadline.
options.zh: D 車；比原本的最晚抵達時間晚三十分鐘。
options.whyZh: D 車有座位，九點三十五分出發、十一點抵達，符合不得早於八點十五分出發及最遲十一點十五分抵達的條件。它比也符合條件的 B 車晚出發；十一點比原本的十點半晚三十分鐘。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 原郵件規定不能早於八點十五分出發、也不接受候補；新情境只把最晚抵達時間改為十一點十五分。A 車太早出發，C 車已客滿，B、D 車都符合；D 車九點三十五分出發較晚，十一點抵達則比原本的十點半晚三十分鐘。
activeQuestion.evidence: Document 2: no Eastford departure before 8:15, original station-arrival deadline 10:30, no waiting list; revised hypothetical deadline 11:15. Document 1: A leaves 8:00, B available at 8:30→10:20, C fully booked at 9:00→10:05, D available at 9:35→11:00. D is the later eligible departure and reaches Milltown 30 minutes after 10:30.

I cannot leave Eastford before 8:15 a.m. My appointment is near Milltown station, and I must arrive at the station no later than 10:30. Please reserve a train that meets both conditions. I do not want to rely on a waiting list.

Booking agent’s reply
I reserved the only available train that fits your times. The fare is NT$180. You may cancel without a fee until thirty minutes before departure; later cancellations are not refundable. Your ticket is attached. Please arrive at the platform at least ten minutes before the train leaves.
